entries.subject: DAMIT 1695: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-1695.txt. Model 1695, version 2016-01-12, pole (91°, -25°), period 25.2285 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: Shape and spin alternatives
entries.finding: Alternative archive models: Model 1696: pole (272°, -17°), period 25.2285 h. The live DAMIT export lists these other models for this target: 1696: pole (272°, -17°), 25.2285 h, version 2016-01-12. These are archive alternatives, not necessarily newly released models or preferred replacements. Comparing their source methods and any pole-specific calibration remains necessary before changing the selected mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: A released numerical replacement or independent pole/size constraints that distinguish the recorded alternatives, followed by comparison against the currently selected model.

entries.subject: PDS SBN catalogue values that disagree with the factsheet or are not shown
entries.finding: The display scale "29.475 km (size-calibrated model)" (akari-acua-v1) implies a diameter of 58.95 km, outside the added NEOWISE V2.0 neowise_mainbelt.csv record 38 (Masiero et al. 2014) diameter 43.218 ± 0.571 km (NEOWISE, NEATM). Both are shown; the display scale is not changed.
entries.revisitWhen: A newer release of the named catalogue, or a review that replaces the shown value.
